# Annotation script attachment references

`generate_annotation_attachment.cjs` executes the unmodified, hash-pinned D2 MathJax 3.2.2 bundle for all 48 original D053 inputs. Each case binds the complete SVG bytes/dimensions and the complete explicit kind/text/attribute/child tree. `generate_script_attachment.cjs` separately calls the actual primary Subscript/Superscript methods for 120 family, occupied-slot, movesupsub and subsupOK combinations. It records selection/reuse and child ownership, then fills the chosen slot through the primary NodeUtil.setChild; compact output kinds only bridge Go's already accepted eager representation.

The original D053 reference baseline was accepted D056 merge `97eebae061dc96a046462472574ef2d6d4772078`. D060 now removes the eight pending-prime SVG/error boundaries and four prime variantForm metadata boundaries. All 48 complete SVGs, including all fourteen required primary errors, match the raw primary. Forty-four explicit trees match; only the four exact preexisting brace accent/accentunder receipts remain. No brace constructor change is included.

The source-shaped attachment helper checks family/subtype and occupied slots before choosing reuse or wrapping. An authored mover stays intact under an outside script; an authored munder with an occupied under slot still rejects a subscript. D056's transient `true` marker identifies eager generic script families. D060 replaces the former eager pending-prime marker with a parse-row-local pair of original nodes; consuming a script still uses this shared attachment helper. Final compilation removes the generic eager-family marker. The source method ownership fixture covers retained wrapper attributes/properties and exact child identities. The source handler does not rewrite authored annotations, disable duplicate-script errors, or change explicit Limits, stackrel, or SVG rendering.

The two D050 subsequent-script qualifications are removed because this fix now makes those complete primary SVG/tree cases exact. The final candidate is based on accepted D054 merge `33983b0fb1d9f4e2a4d940e8f4d45a709d02012a`, whose separate stackrel correction removes the other two historical D050 qualifications. All 50 coupled stack-placement references therefore require raw primary SVG/tree equality. The historical 48 annotation baseline outputs were byte-identical across those two accepted parents. D060 upgrades only the precisely bound prime cases described above. No dimension edits or paint tolerances are used.
